title: Aoyagi Toya — On Foreign Streets〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: New York Academy of Music - Outside the dorm

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning, Azusawa, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Morning, Aoyagi, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
This dorm's beds are really nice!
I basically fell asleep the second I lay down on mine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this place has better beds than any of the cheap hotels around here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they were very comfortable.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Anyway, the cafeteria on campus that Mr. Lloyd told us about should be opening soon...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Let's go get some breakfast.
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hm? A message?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, it's from Shuji...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you told him that we managed to meet up with Mr. Lloyd, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, he replied just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We ended up asking him for help just after arriving here, and he really saved us.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'd like to thank him in a more direct manner... Actually, he just replied to my message, so does that mean I can call him now?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll see you over at the cafeteria, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Please give your brother our regards.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, let him know he's a lifesaver and we really appreciate what he did for us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (They're all so considerate...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Anyway, I should first ask to see if he's free to talk right now...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (We just spoke yesterday, but I'm a little anxious about calling him for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Morning, Toya.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good morning, Shuji.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I really appreciate what you did for us yesterday. We were able to stay in one of the dorms thanks to you and Mr. Lloyd.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<Yeah, he let me know already.
How is your team doing? Good?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we were all able to get a good night's rest. They all wanted me to thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <That's good to hear.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I know you're busy with your performance right now...

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<Don't worry about that.
I'm the one who said to ask if you ever needed help, remember?>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <If anything, I'm glad that you reached out to me. Not often I get a chance to help you like a big brother should.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <You know, Professor Lloyd said that you remind him of Dad.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, yes... He did say that to me as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Also, I haven't had much chance to ask about this yet, but he told us Dad spent six months studying at the New York Academy of Music as an exchange student...

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<Ah, that.
He really does enjoy telling stories about Dad.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <To be fair, he was at Dad's wedding, so I have to think that they're really close friends.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
That comes as a surprise. I'd only heard that they were classmates.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <He'll probably tell you all about Dad if you keep asking him. Actually, he might not be able to stop once you get him going.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Dad's friends with a lot of musicians in Europe and the United States.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Every time I meet one of them, they ask, “What is Harumichi doing in Japan these days?” and, “When is he visiting here next?”>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Surprised?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I am...

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Remember that trip to Europe we took as a family when we were little?>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <This huge crowd of famous musicians gathered in the hotel we were staying at after word got out that Dad brought his entire family.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Just as things were about to get totally out of hand, he told them to “get lost and go home”. The looks on those musicians' faces were priceless.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Really...?
I don't remember any of that.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <To be fair, you were very little.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line:
<Oh...
I need to start getting ready soon.>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <There are plenty more interesting stories about Dad, and Professor Lloyd knows many of them. You should ask him if you get the chance.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <Toya...>

rows.Speaker: Shuji
rows.Line: <We won't be able to see each other this time around due to my performance, but let's try to meet in person soon.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be looking forward to seeing you.
